title: HoloCity Placement Palette
description: Catalog of placeable prefabs, exported by Unity alongside the scene. The web editor's add-from-library sidebar is built from this and ONLY this — a prefabPath not in the palette can never appear in a diff's added[], and a materialVariant key not declared here can never be applied.

defaultRotation.description: The prefab root's own axis-fix rotation. The web editor SEEDS an added item with this and thereafter stores the ABSOLUTE rotation; the importer assigns that absolute value. Do NOT compose on the Unity side — 1.0.0's text said compose and the importer did, which applied the axis fix twice on the ~92% of palette items whose default is non-identity.

materialVariants.description: The CLOSED SET of named material swaps allowed for this prefab. A diff may name a key from this list and nothing else; material asset paths never cross the boundary, for the same reason arbitrary prefabPaths do not. Sourced from HoloCityVariantSet assets in the project — an empty or absent list means this prefab has no variants.

key.description: stable id, referenced by placement_diff state.materialVariant

swatch.description: optional hex colour the web editor can show without loading the material
